h1: Snow Removal in the Bemidji & Leech Lake Area
metaTitle: Snow Removal in Bemidji, MN | Shepard Excavating
metaDesc: Driveway and commercial snow plowing across the Bemidji and Leech Lake area all winter. Seasonal routes fill up, so call (218) 224-2754 early.
lead: Driveways and commercial lots cleared through the long Northern Minnesota winter. Reliable plowing so you can get where you are going.
factors: Size of the driveway or lot
How often you want it cleared (per storm or seasonal)
timeline: We run routes during and after storms. Get on the list before the season fills up.
expect: We plow it clean and stack the snow out of your way. Long lake-country drives and commercial lots are no problem.

faqs.q: Do you plow residential and commercial?
faqs.a: Both. Driveways, long rural drives, and commercial lots are all on our routes.

faqs.q: Can I sign up for the whole season?
faqs.a: Yes. Seasonal service means you do not have to call after every storm. Sign up early before the routes fill.
Yes, we remove ice dams as part of our winter work.

faqs.q: When should I get on the list?
faqs.a: Before the snow flies. Routes fill up, so the earlier you call, the better.
